title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Omneky ships a public API + MCP server for autonomous ad creative — URL in, finished ads out
bullets.summary: Launched Jul 10; an agent (incl. Claude) passes a brand URL and Omneky returns on-brand creative in every aspect ratio (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9) plus UGC + short-form video, with performance-driven regeneration.
bullets.how: A drop-in creative engine for Brand 9 Signs and PRAGMA client ad ops; wrap it behind Pulse so 'make launch ads for this product page' is one agent call. Pressure-test its multi-format output against our signage/social deliverables before committing.

bullets.title: Anthropic adds enterprise-managed MCP connector access (starting with Okta)
bullets.summary: Admins provision connectors once and users get zero-touch access on first login, with centralized authorization across Claude chat, Claude Code, and Cowork for Team/Enterprise.
bullets.how: The governance layer The Construct's growing connector fleet needs: provision + authorize MCPs once, centrally, not per-agent. Maps to our installed-skills / connector registry — treat connector auth as an admin-provisioned asset.

bullets.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.1 — its first paid model, a low-cost agentic coder
bullets.summary: Released Jul 9 at $1.25/$4.25 per 1M tokens, positioned as an agentic coding model — Meta's first move to monetize the Muse line.
bullets.how: Another routing-layer input alongside Sonnet 5 / GPT-5.6 / Grok 4.5; the aggressive price point makes it a candidate for high-volume, low-stakes coding jobs. Bench it, but keep provider-agnostic routing so it's a config change, not a rebuild.

bullets.title: Anthropic brings Claude Code + Cowork to Government in a FedRAMP High environment
bullets.summary: Announced Jul 7; Claude Code and Cowork are in public beta via Claude for Government Desktop, delivered under FedRAMP High authorization.
bullets.how: Not a direct B9 need, but a PRAGMA signal: the same agent substrate The Construct runs on is now credentialed for regulated/public-sector buyers, widening the addressable market for AI-operator consulting.

bullets.title: arXiv: "Context Engineering — From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture"
bullets.summary: Proposes five context-quality criteria (relevance, sufficiency, isolation, economy, provenance), frames context as the agent's OS, and introduces intent engineering + specification engineering for autonomous multi-agent operation at scale.
bullets.how: A clean framework for hardening The Construct's memory + CLAUDE.md governance: treat locked rules, agent memories, and connector policies as a versioned, machine-readable spec corpus and grade each context source against the five criteria.

praxis_lesson: The morning's big-platform items (Sonnet 5, Cowork mobile/web, Claude-in-Chrome GA) were the headline, but the later fire is where the operator-level plumbing showed up — a vertical creative MCP (Omneky) that collapses ad production to one call, and admin-provisioned connector governance (Okta) that finally makes a large MCP fleet manageable. The move is the same both ways: adopt vertical MCPs behind Pulse and lean on Anthropic's new connector-governance layer rather than hand-rolling auth, while keeping original work in provider-agnostic model routing and owned orchestration.
